name: Kingdom of the Netherlands

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 33,670 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 18,087,633. European Netherlands inside ne:NLD; Caribbean constituent countries excluded.

activePersonnel.note: IISS as quoted: 33,650 active (Royal Marechaussee 6,800 paramilitary excluded). High: CIA Factbook 2025 ~43,000 active-duty professional personnel (counting definition differs).

trainedReserves.note: IISS as quoted: 6,350 reserves; high allows for the planned expansion of the national reserve.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 33,650 minus infantry P roles (5,500). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Small all-volunteer force with dormant conscription law and no stored equipment; analogy to 1940 Netherlands (~280,000 from 8.8 million, ~3%) at the low end.

count.note: Educated guess. 13 Light Brigade/43 Mechanized Brigade infantry battalions on CV90/Boxer. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Royal_Netherlands_Army)

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): CV90 Mk III, Boxer.

count.note: Educated guess. 11 Airmobile Brigade and Korps Mariniers (~2,500 marines in total, partly counted). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Royal_Netherlands_Army)

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): Modern light kit, Bushmaster.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly above): Marines and air assault infantry well trained.

count.note: Leopard 2A6MA2 18, serving in the German-Dutch 414 Panzer Battalion; 46 Leopard 2A8 ordered for delivery 2028-31.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): Leopard 2A6.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army): Professional, integrated with German Panzer battalion.

count.note: CV9035NL 128 + Boxer 200 + Bushmaster 102 + Fennek 345 + Fuchs 16 = 791 (Fennek is a light armoured recce vehicle).

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best) (slightly below): CV90 and Boxer modern; Fennek light.

count.note: Educated guess. PzH 2000 count not given on the fetched equipment page (some donated to Ukraine; ~35 assumed) + PULS 4 delivered (20 on order). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Royal_Netherlands_Army)

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): PzH 2000 with Excalibur; PULS arriving.

count.note: Inventory: F-35A 52 (5 more on order); F-16 retired 2024 (transferred to Ukraine/Romania).

quality.note: Rubric quality 1.0 (the era's best) (slightly below): All-F-35 fighter force.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly above): Professional.

count.note: AH-64E 28 + CH-47F 20 + NH90 19 + AS532 Cougar 12 = 79 (H225M on order).

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best) (slightly above): AH-64E, CH-47F modern.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly above): Professional.

count.note: MQ-9A 8 (Air Force) + RQ-21 Blackjack 15 + ScanEagle 12 (Army list) = 35. Raven/Puma/Wasp minis excluded.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best) (slightly below): MQ-9A modern.

count.note: Frigates 6 (4 De Zeven Provincien air-defence frigates + 2 Karel Doorman).

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best) (slightly above): LCF frigates with SM-2/ESSM and APAR.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly above): Professional.

count.note: OPV 4 (Holland class) + amphibious ships 3 (2 LPD + JSS) + mine warfare 3 = 10.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best) (slightly below): Modern OPVs and LPDs.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly above): Professional.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.5 (era-typical) (slightly above): Walrus is a 1990s design near end of life.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly above): Professional.

count.note: Patriot 4 fire units + NASAMS II 2 fire units + Fennek Stinger 18 (~3 batteries) = 9; NASAMS-3 (21) and Skyranger 30 on order.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best) (slightly above): Patriot PAC-3 MSE.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly above): Professional.

commandQuality.note: Rubric commandQuality 0.75 (trained staff system, proven commanders) (slightly below): NATO-integrated staff (1 German-Netherlands Corps), Afghanistan/Mali operations.

cohesion.note: Rubric cohesion 0.75 (professional with strong unit identity) (slightly below): Professional; Korps Mariniers strong identity.

weapons.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: JASSM, Tomahawk ordered, ESSM/SM-2, PULS.

armor.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: No national tank force beyond 18 Leopard 2A6.

ships.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: LCF air-defence frigates.

fortification.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Patriot/NASAMS layered GBAD.

logistics.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: A330 MRTT pool, JSS Karel Doorman.

communications.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Link 16, Thales C2 systems.

isr.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: MQ-9A, F-35 sensors.

cyber.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Defence Cyber Command.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 1,033,499,815,708 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 18,087,633 = 57,138. Range +/-10%.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 1,291,067,852,227 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 1,033,499,815,708 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 2.19% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 1.94% in 2024, 1.37% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 17.7% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. World second-largest agri-food exporter by value; imports much feed.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 8,987,375 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 5.667% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 101,854. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

ships_major.note: Educated guess. Damen Naval Vlissingen builds ASWF frigates with Belgium.

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. Small national assembly share.

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 3,041 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 18 ports, 2 large + 4 medium = 6 (Rotterdam is Europe's largest port).

merchantTonnage.note: UNCTAD 2025 as quoted: 6,777 thousand DWT under the Dutch flag.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. By analogy to NATO mechanized brigade sustainment (truck-based, depots every ~150-200 km).

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. The Netherlands hosts US B61 bombs at Volkel under NATO nuclear sharing (FAS); not counted.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.1: familiar polder terrain with water obstacles, local supply; no depth.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: European Netherlands inside ne:NLD. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Force counts from the Wikipedia Royal Netherlands Army equipment list, the Air and Space Force inventory and the active navy ship list; drones = Group 2+ only. PzH 2000 count is an educated guess (grade D). Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Royal Marechaussee excluded.
